paginas.contenido:
In this unit, we focus on the skills required to work as a Junior IT Technician or Developer in an international company.

💡 Nota: Esta unidad te prepara para trabajar en entornos internacionales, especialmente en el Reino Unido.

Learning Goals:

  • Understand British workplace culture and protocols.
  • Identify different types of professional IT documents.
  • Master the use of Relative Clauses to define technical components.
  • Use the Passive Voice to write objective technical reports.
  • Correctly apply Prepositions of Place and Time.
  • Expand IT-specific vocabulary with Phrasal Verbs.

Communication in the UK is traditionally polite and indirect. Avoiding direct confrontation is key.

💡 Nota: En el Reino Unido la comunicación es educada e indirecta para evitar conflictos.

Key Protocols:

  • Softening Expressions: Use "Could you possibly...?" or "Would you mind...?" instead of direct commands.
  • Punctuality: Essential. Being late is considered very unprofessional.
  • Hierarchies: Often informal. It's common to use first names with supervisors.
  • Small Talk: Common at the start of meetings to build rapport.

Clarity and accuracy are essential in the IT sector.

💡 Nota: Cada documento tiene un propósito y lenguaje específico.

Document TypeMain Purpose
Professional EmailDaily communication with clients/teams.
Technical ReportSystem analysis. Uses Passive Voice.
User ManualStep-by-step instructions. Uses Imperatives.
Incident ReportDescribes unexpected events. Uses Past Simple.
CV / ResumeSummary of Education and Skills.

Relative pronouns link parts of a sentence to provide more info without starting new sentences.

💡 Nota: Los pronombres relativos unen oraciones para dar más información sobre alguien o algo.

  • WHO: People (subject). "The admin who managed the server..."
  • WHOM: People (object). "The technician whom I called..."
  • WHOSE: Possession. "The user whose password expired..."
  • WHICH: Objects. "The software which was updated..."
  • WHERE: Places. "The data center where we store logs..."

Used in reports to sound objective and formal. Focuses on the action, not the person.

💡 Nota: La voz pasiva se usa para ser objetivo, centrándose en la acción (ej. "El sistema fue testeado").

Structure:

Subject + Be + Past Participle

Examples:

  • "The system was tested under different conditions."
  • "A server outage has been detected."
  • "The network will be upgraded next weekend."

Correct prepositions are vital for technical logs and locations. CLICK IMAGE TO ZOOM.

💡 Nota: AT (punto exacto), IN (dentro de), ON (sobre superficie/plataforma).

  • AT: A specific point. "At the door", "at the rack".
  • IN: Inside a space. "In the bag", "in the server room".
  • ON: A surface/platform. "On the table", "on the screen".

Essential for scheduling maintenance and SLA logs. CLICK IMAGE TO ZOOM.

💡 Nota: AT (horas), ON (días/fechas), IN (meses/años/periodos).

  • AT: Specific times. "At 7 o'clock", "at midnight".
  • ON: Days and dates. "On Monday", "on May 3rd".
  • IN: Months, years, and periods. "In 2026", "in the morning".

Phrasal verbs are common in technical daily communication.

💡 Nota: Verbos compuestos muy comunes en IT. ¡Memorízalos!

  • Boot off: To force disconnect. "The admin had to boot off the intruder."
  • Link on: To connect/attach. "Try to link on the new feature."
  • Log up: To record progress/time. "You should log up your hours."
  • Hack on: To work on something (improvised). "He decided to hack on the code."

Review these core concepts before the final test.
  • Culture: Indirect, polite, punctual. Managers are addressed by first name.
  • Documents: Reports (Passive), Manuals (Imperative), Emails (Formal).
  • Grammar: Relative clauses define components; Passive voice ensures objectivity.
  • Prepositions: AT (specific), IN (enclosed), ON (surface).
  • Vocabulary: Mastering IT phrasal verbs improves terminal communication.
Complete this test to confirm you have mastered the Unit 8 content. Select the correct answer for each question.

preguntas_test.q: Which type of document typically uses imperative verbs such as 'Download' or 'Restart'?
preguntas_test.explicacion: Los manuales de usuario dan instrucciones directas paso a paso. Por ello, se usan verbos imperativos.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'Restart the server after the installation is complete.'

preguntas_test.q: What is the primary purpose of using Passive Voice in a technical report?
preguntas_test.explicacion: La voz pasiva centra la atención en la acción y el objeto, eliminando la subjetividad del autor.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'The vulnerability was identified during the audit' suena más profesional que 'I found a bug'.

preguntas_test.q: In a British company, how is it appropriate to address your manager?
options: Using formal titles at all times
preguntas_test.explicacion: A pesar de la jerarquía, la cultura laboral británica es relativamente informal en el trato diario, usando nombres de pila.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'Morning John, could you check the logs?' en lugar de 'Mr. Smith'.

preguntas_test.q: Which preposition is correct for a specific day of the week (e.g., Wednesday)?
preguntas_test.explicacion: Usamos siempre 'ON' para días de la semana y fechas específicas.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'The backup is scheduled on Wednesday night.'

preguntas_test.q: What does the phrasal verb 'Boot off' mean in an IT context?
options: To force a user to disconnect
preguntas_test.explicacion: 'Boot off' se usa cuando el sistema o el administrador expulsan a un usuario de la sesión o red.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'The system will boot you off if you remain idle for 10 minutes.'

preguntas_test.q: Which relative pronoun is used to show possession?
preguntas_test.explicacion: 'Whose' equivale a 'cuyo/a' y se utiliza para indicar a quién pertenece algo.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'The user whose account was blocked called support.'

preguntas_test.q: Which document is usually concise and includes sections like 'Education' and 'Skills'?
preguntas_test.explicacion: Un CV (Curriculum Vitae) es el documento estándar para resumir la trayectoria académica y habilidades técnicas.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'Include your Python certification in the Skills section of your CV.'

preguntas_test.q: What is the correct preposition for a specific point in time (e.g., 7 o'clock)?
preguntas_test.explicacion: Usamos 'AT' para momentos precisos del reloj o periodos muy concretos.

preguntas_test.q: Which register is typically used in professional emails?
preguntas_test.explicacion: Los correos profesionales requieren un registro formal, con saludos y despedidas estándar.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: Usar 'Dear Sir/Madam' y 'Kind regards' en lugar de 'Hey' o 'Bye'.

preguntas_test.q: Which word is used to refer to places in a relative clause?
preguntas_test.explicacion: 'Where' es el pronombre relativo específico para referirse a lugares o localizaciones físicas/lógicas.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'This is the folder where the configuration files are stored.'
